name: @sos-2/live-store
description: SOS 2.0 Live Persistence (Work Order P2): durable, provider-neutral repositories for the live product state — Mission, Context, SystemState, Evidence, Architecture, Candidate, Assurance, Experiment, Decision, AuthorityGrant, Package, history (memory/causal/provenance), development state, task state, body-lease state and observation events — plus the three provider PORTS (PostgresStoreAdapter -> Neon durable semantic state; RedisCoordinationAdapter -> Upstash cache/idempotency/leases, NEVER CANONICAL; ObjectStoreAdapter -> Cloudflare R2 large immutable artifacts by content hash) with complete in-memory reference implementations. SEMANTIC DISCIPLINE (hard): semantic ids and exact revisions are stored and returned VERBATIM (validated by the owning frozen domain packages' guards, never re-minted, never rewritten); truth states and provenance are preserved bit-exact (store->load round-trip equality on canonical serialization, consumed from @sos-2/semantic-spine); idempotent writes (identical replay = no-op returning the stored record); stale-revision detection (typed conflict record carrying the current revision — optimistic concurrency); durable task/checkpoint records per spec/productization-execution-architecture.md section 6; event ingestion with replay protection (every event carries an id; duplicates are typed and skipped, never double-applied); explicit UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE provider failure model (typed availability records, never fabricated success, never silent absence-of-failure). Domain packages never import provider specifics; provider adapters target Neon/Upstash/R2 later without contract change.
